name: Aerodynamics
description: Introduction, aerodynamic forces and moments, governing equations, kinematics: streamlines, pathlines, and streaklines, vorticity and circulation, stream function, velocity potential, elementary flows, non/lifting flow past a cylinder, Kutta-Joukowski theorem, panel method, Kutta condition, Kelvin’s circulation theorem, classical thin airfoil theory lifting flows over arbitrary bodies: the vortex panel numerical method, viscous flow, induced drag in wings, Biot-Savart law, Helmholtz’s theorems, Prandtl’s classical lifting-line theory, aircraft aerodynamics, unsteady aerodynamics: topics such as flapping wing, turbines and flow induced vibrations, and road vehicle aerodynamics
